'''Cynabar's Infonet''', known colloquially as the '''Big CYN''', was a news broadcast founded by a mysterious [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known only as "[[Cynabar]]." The aim of the service was to make smugglers and traders aware of business opportunities and the activities of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It also followed the exploits of prominent smugglers, and being mentioned in Cynabar's Infonet was a sign that a smuggler had risen to above average notability.<ref name="SWAJ3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

Access to Cynabar's Infonet was very exclusive and costly, and was only made available by invitation. Smugglers interested in access to the service needed to either distinguish themselves well enough to be recognized by local dealers, or else tap contacts in the so-called "[[old being network]]" to obtain it.<ref name="SWAJ3" />

[[File:Cynabars_InfoNet-2.svg|thumb|left|200px|Another Cynabar's InfoNet logo.]]

Cynabar's Infonet was remarkably well informed. For example, at a time when most military personnel in the Empire were unaware of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo's]] secret promotion to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]], Cynabar was not only aware of this fact, but reported on the Grand Admiral's movements between the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="SWAJ11">{{JournalCite|11|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

[[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] reporter [[Andor Javin]] claimed that Cynabar was notorious [[Brentaalan]] smuggler [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]]. However, Javin's journalistic methodology was far from meticulous, and thus the identification of Cynabar as Okeefe is uncertain.<ref name="SWAJ8">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

[[Privateer/Legends|Privateers]] associated to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] captured [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Aricos Dreleene]] and his ship, the supposed-[[L19a freighter]] ''[[Almost Authentic|First Edition]]''. Dreleene confessed that the ''First Edition'' was really a counterfeit made after a less-exclusive [[Surronian L19 heavy freighter/Legends|L19 Heavy Freighter]]. The Alliance then uploaded his confession to Cynabar's Infonet. When the Empire discovered that Dreleene had tried to outwit them in parties, they decided to not attempt to rescue Dreleene, instead revoking his Moffship.<ref name="ss">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
